# TinoMakesDev

> Official website of TinoMakesDev. Free, source-available, privacy-focused, and local-first desktop applications.

## Applications

- [Memory Calendar](https://tinomakesdev.github.io/memory-calendar.html): A free, source-available, offline photo organizer and viewer for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It automatically sorts media libraries into a visual calendar (Days, Months, Years) using EXIF data or folder names. 

## Key Features of Memory Calendar
- Free photo organizer and viewer.
- 100% offline, privacy-focused, no cloud sync, no telemetry.
- 5 View modes: Days, Months, Years, Events, Duplicates.
- Duplicate photo detection using SHA-256 hashing.
- Safe deletion: files go to an app-managed Trash folder, undoable with Ctrl+Z.
- Virtual "Events" allow grouping photos from different folders without duplicating files.
- Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC/HEIF, WEBP, TIFF, and video (MP4, MOV, AVI).
